cases.why: the report is decoded in the machine's codec again: fine on Linux CI, a crash on markys (cp1252) the next time a failure message carries a byte cp1252 cannot map, and the case goes unreported

this side decodes UTF-8 but the child writes in its own codec; on a cp1252 machine an en dash arrives as one byte that UTF-8 turns into a replacement character, and the report no longer says what it said
the child opens files in the machine's codec again, so on Windows a case that drops an encoding= is caught by the conftest build crashing first and reported WRONG-GUARD there only
